title: Product OS
summary: A product operating system: structured specifications, AI agents and context engineering to take an idea to working software. The app is the implementation of that system.
problem: Building software with AI agents works well in demos and poorly in real projects: context gets lost, decisions go unrecorded and every session starts almost from scratch.
audience: Myself building my own products, and in the medium term any maker working with AI agents.
role: Full design and implementation: defining the system, the architecture and building the app.
responsibilities: Defining the specification model: how to describe a product so an agent can build it.
Designing the orchestration flows: which tasks each agent handles and in what order.
Building the application that implements the system.
Testing the system by using it to develop other real projects.
decisions: The specification is the source of truth: code can be regenerated, intent cannot.
Explicit, versioned context instead of long conversations that degrade.
The app and the method evolve together: every real project feeds the system.
outcomes: An AI-assisted development flow I use daily on my projects.
Several products built with the system, including this website.
